Use case: stylized-concept. Professional Japanese 2D visual novel CHARACTER MODEL SHEET for a unified simplified redesign. Fine clean dark outline; LARGE solid local-color shapes, ONE hard-edged shadow per material, tiny restrained highlights, matte fabric, simple expressive anime face, adult elegant proportions, no painterly gradients, no dense rendering. Warm very pale grey plain opaque sheet background. No scenery, effects, shadows on ground, decorative border, UI, logos or text.
REFERENCE ROLE: Image 1 is legacy identity ancestry ONLY: preserve recognizable face, species and fundamental hair coloring. Discard its ornate costume and implement the new design below. If the legacy image conflicts with the new text, the new text wins. Do not copy particles, scenery or detail density.
NEW DESIGN: Adult fox shrine officiant, 168 cm, long chestnut-red hair to hips, green eyes, two fox ears and exactly THREE separate red fox tails with white tips. White cross-collar wide-sleeved ceremonial top, crimson collar and cuff borders, ankle-length deep-green skirt, plain deep-green waist sash. ONE simple red leaf-shaped hair clip at HER RIGHT temple. Flat sandals. No flower clusters, bells, chains, flame embroidery or extra tails. All three tails originate at lower back, separated for counting in rear view.
SHEET: landscape 2048x1536, three large equal-scale full-body orthographic views arranged left to right FRONT, HER RIGHT SIDE profile, BACK. Same neutral relaxed A-pose, feet aligned, entire head and both feet inside sheet, consistent height and identical clothing construction in every view. Character alone with empty hands. Do NOT include weapon, magic or detached props. Stowed case, scabbard or belt item may appear only when specified. Keep asymmetric details on the same ANATOMICAL side across views: front-view character right is viewer left; back-view character right is viewer right. No text labels.
COSTUME INVARIANTS: 绿眼栗红发; 尾3条白尖; 右鬓叶片1枚; 折扇1把; 纸符3张.
